description:
Energy bills are still hitting households hard in 2026, but millions of people still do not realise they could qualify for free home energy upgrades, insulation grants, rebates, or help with heating systems and smart thermostats.

The problem is not that help does not exist. The problem is knowing where to look — and who to trust.

The UK government has committed almost £15 billion toward improving home energy efficiency by 2030, while ENERGY STAR estimates smart thermostats can reduce heating and cooling costs by around 8% on average.

At The Thermo Expert, we break everything down in simple, practical English without all the confusing jargon.

This channel covers smart thermostats, heating advice, heat pumps, insulation, grants, rebates, energy-saving tips, and honest home upgrade guidance for households across the UK, USA, Canada, and Europe.

www.thethermoexpert.com
